dpdp_alignment: DPDP Act 2023 - Section 6 (Purpose Limitation & Data Minimization)

customer_support.description: Handling customer complaints, order inquiries, and account status requests.
customer_support.dpdp_clause: Section 6(1) - Processing strictly necessary for resolving requested support ticket.

loan_processing.description: Evaluating customer creditworthiness, KYC verification, and loan sanctioning.
loan_processing.dpdp_clause: Section 6(2) - KYC & Credit risk assessment under regulatory compliance.

marketing.description: Drafting personalized newsletters, promotional pitches, and product recommendations.
marketing.dpdp_clause: Section 6(1) - Strict Data Minimization; financial and identity credentials strictly prohibited.

fraud_investigation.description: Analyzing suspicious transactions, anomalous account behavior, and security audits.
fraud_investigation.dpdp_clause: Section 17(1)(c) - Prevention and detection of financial fraud and legal obligations.

general_inquiry.description: General text generation, brainstorming, code assistance, and summarization.
general_inquiry.dpdp_clause: Section 6 - Minimization; no personal identifiers allowed in general LLM queries.
